claim: The Security Pillar (SEC04-BP02) recommends considering aggregating all relevant sources of security log data into a Log Archive account; capturing this data in standardized locations in a separate AWS account with proper cross-account permissions helps prevent log tampering within compromised workloads and environments and gives a single integration point for additional tools.

evidence.quote: To overcome these challenges, consider aggregating all relevant sources of security log data into a Log Archive account as described in [Organizing Your AWS Environment Using Multiple Accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/organizing-your-aws-environment/security-ou-and-accounts.html#log-archive-account).

There are several benefits to capturing this data in standardized locations in a separate AWS account with proper cross-account permissions. This practice helps prevent log tampering within compromised workloads and environments, provides a single integration point for additional tools, and offers a more simplified model for configuring data retention and lifecycle.
